datasets.name: ds_month
queryLines:
SELECT month, route, count(*) AS contracts FROM (SELECT e.umr, e.insured_name, e.class_of_business, e.broker_name,
                      regexp_extract(e.slip_leader, 'Syndicate ([0-9]+)', 0) AS slip_leader,
                      e.premium_currency, e.premium_amount, e.signed_lines_total, e.certainty_status,
                      concat(e.schema_name, ' ', e.schema_version) AS schema_version,
                      date_format(d.ingested_at, 'yyyy-MM') AS month,
                      CASE WHEN a.entity_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'No person involved' ELSE 'After a decision by a person' END AS route
               FROM lr_dev_aws_us_catalog.document_gateway.v_mrc_entities_latest e JOIN lr_dev_aws_us_catalog.document_gateway.source_document d ON e.source_document_id = d.doc_id
               LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT entity_id FROM lr_dev_aws_us_catalog.document_gateway.audit_event WHERE event_type = 'auto_ingested') a
                 ON a.entity_id = d.doc_id) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

datasets.name: ds_premium
queryLines:
SELECT class_of_business, premium_currency, round(sum(premium_amount), 0) AS premium
                            FROM (SELECT e.umr, e.insured_name, e.class_of_business, e.broker_name,
                      regexp_extract(e.slip_leader, 'Syndicate ([0-9]+)', 0) AS slip_leader,
                      e.premium_currency, e.premium_amount, e.signed_lines_total, e.certainty_status,
                      concat(e.schema_name, ' ', e.schema_version) AS schema_version,
                      date_format(d.ingested_at, 'yyyy-MM') AS month,
                      CASE WHEN a.entity_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'No person involved' ELSE 'After a decision by a person' END AS route
               FROM lr_dev_aws_us_catalog.document_gateway.v_mrc_entities_latest e JOIN lr_dev_aws_us_catalog.document_gateway.source_document d ON e.source_document_id = d.doc_id
               LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT entity_id FROM lr_dev_aws_us_catalog.document_gateway.audit_event WHERE event_type = 'auto_ingested') a
                 ON a.entity_id = d.doc_id) WHERE premium_currency IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC

datasets.name: ds_rules
queryLines:
SELECT label AS market_rule, count(*) AS contracts FROM lr_dev_aws_us_catalog.document_gateway.v_mrc_certainty_latest
                            WHERE status = 'fail' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

datasets.name: ds_attention
queryLines:
SELECT b.umr, b.insured_name, b.class_of_business, b.broker_name, c.label AS failed_rule, c.detail
                            FROM (SELECT e.umr, e.insured_name, e.class_of_business, e.broker_name,
                      regexp_extract(e.slip_leader, 'Syndicate ([0-9]+)', 0) AS slip_leader,
                      e.premium_currency, e.premium_amount, e.signed_lines_total, e.certainty_status,
                      concat(e.schema_name, ' ', e.schema_version) AS schema_version,
                      date_format(d.ingested_at, 'yyyy-MM') AS month,
                      CASE WHEN a.entity_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'No person involved' ELSE 'After a decision by a person' END AS route
               FROM lr_dev_aws_us_catalog.document_gateway.v_mrc_entities_latest e JOIN lr_dev_aws_us_catalog.document_gateway.source_document d ON e.source_document_id = d.doc_id
               LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT entity_id FROM lr_dev_aws_us_catalog.document_gateway.audit_event WHERE event_type = 'auto_ingested') a
                 ON a.entity_id = d.doc_id) b JOIN lr_dev_aws_us_catalog.document_gateway.v_mrc_entities_latest e ON e.umr = b.umr
                            JOIN lr_dev_aws_us_catalog.document_gateway.v_mrc_certainty_latest c ON c.mrc_id = e.mrc_id AND c.status = 'fail' ORDER BY b.umr
